column1: # facts/facts.tsv -- the single source of truth for every RVA, offset, stride, mask and
# constant this project depends on.  Owned by W0-2.  Other packets
# contribute rows via facts/pending/<packet>.tsv; gen_facts.py merges them.
# addr_space  PC_VA | PC_RVA | LIBR15_VA | OFFSET | CONST     -- what KIND of number it is
# provenance  PC | ARM64 | UNKNOWN                            -- which BINARY it was read from
# rival_arm   what libr15 uses for the SAME field, or `-` if not looked up, or `none`
#             if libr15 has no counterpart.  The rival is the discriminating test:
#             value-rarity is not, because PHYS.CI_STRIDE's 504 occurs 2199 times in
#             .text and a rarity filter would have called it unverifiable.
#   These are independent.  A stride, count, cap or mask lifted from libr15 is just as
#   unusable on PC as a libr15 address is, and it does not announce itself in the
#   addr_space column -- PHYS.CI_STRIDE was `CONST 520` and was ARM64.  Only provenance
#   PC is emitted as a usable constant; ARM64 is withheld exactly like a LIBR15_VA, and
#   UNKNOWN means nobody has re-derived it against PC code yet.
# tier        V-PRIMARY  confirmed against the real echovr.exe on disk by this packet
#             V          confirmed against an independent extraction of the same build
#             U          not re-derived on PC -- loud at startup, never silent
# value       hex for every address and offset (S2 F4); decimal only in `comment`
# source_a/b  must name two sources that resolve to DIFFERENT documents or artifacts;
#             tier V and V-PRIMARY additionally require one the code cannot fabricate
# verdict     PC_DECISIVE      read back out of echovr.exe at a site whose base register
#                              or symbol is attributable -- the value could not be another
#             PC_CORROBORATED  present at the cited site and independently extracted
#             PC_PRESENT       occurs in PC code, but nothing distinguishes it from any
#                              other value that would fit.  NOT A PASS (docs/PC_DERIVATION.md)
#             PC_ABSENT        not at the cited site: REFUSED, withheld from the header
#             NOT_IN_CODE      correctly absent from .text -- a Wwise id lives in a .bnk
#             ARM64_ONLY       a libr15 number; withheld from the header
#   The verdict CONSTRAINS the tier: only PC_DECISIVE and PC_CORROBORATED may be V or
#   V-PRIMARY, and PC_ABSENT / ARM64_ONLY are not emitted at all.  The classification was
#   already written down in PC_DERIVATION.md and nothing read it, which let a PC_PRESENT
#   row be marked verified.  An analysis with no consumer is decoration.
# effect      what the BODY does, as an operation rather than a verb (S4.6 rule 9):
#             "clears 0x01000000 at +0xBC", "writes both ci+288 and ci+292".  A bit is a
#             query; a verb is a judgement, and N-7 was a verb ("wake") agreeing with a
#             name ("GoToSleep") that did the opposite.  `-` means nobody has read the body.
#             INCLUDING WHAT IT TAIL-CALLS INTO: a terminal jmp is a continuation, not a
#             return, and sub_140127960 never writes clock+104 in its own body -- the
#             store is in what it jumps to. Follow the chain to a real ret.
# base        what an OFFSET is measured FROM.  "0x88 from what?" is the question that
#             caught AUDIO.SINK_REFCOUNT_OFF: the value was read correctly, off the
#             OnBufferEnd callback argument, and named for the sink.  No other column
#             asks it -- provenance says which binary, verb/observed and effect say what
#             the function does, and none of them is the base.
